visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a high-detail close-up shot of a pair of legs tightly encased in complex metal and leather orthopedic braces, seated in a wheelchair. The camera then cuts to an eye-level tracking shot showing a blonde woman in a yellow shirt sitting in the wheelchair while a man in a blue t-shirt pushes her across a paved path with a background of lush green hills and a bright sky. (2) The scene transitions to a wide full shot of the same woman, now standing upright on a rugged, grassy hillside under bright sunlight. She is dressed in a sleeveless pink top and denim shorts, supporting herself with a long wooden walking staff as she surveys the surrounding mountains and valleys. Her expression appears calm and determined as she stands without the wheelchair. (3) The setting changes to an indoor home environment with soft, warm lighting. The woman, now in a yellow sleeveless top, is sitting in her wheelchair and is shown in a medium close-up as she carefully adjusts and buckles the various black leather straps on her heavy leg braces. The background features bookshelves and typical domestic furniture, creating a personal and intimate atmosphere. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hands as she physically lifts one of her braced legs from the ground into the footwell of a car. The final sequence introduces a man with short blonde hair and orange-tinted glasses indoors. He is first seen looking out a window and then sitting on a grey sofa, where he pulls a thick white fabric sleeve over his leg, which appears to be part of a simulated or actual amputation management process.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Case Study -> Definition -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience about Body Integrity Identity Disorder (BIID), a rare psychological condition where able-bodied individuals strongly desire to have a physical disability. The video uses compelling case studies and clinical definitions to foster understanding of this complex mental health issue.
